documents.text: Regarding your upcoming booking, please note that the entire payment will be returned as money with no deduction if you cancel before the cutoff date. Your accommodation features an operational swimming pool on the premises, available throughout your stay without any separate fee. Additionally, the quoted amount fully covers a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, so nothing further needs to be paid. Please be aware of our arrival protocol: a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. We recommend securing this authorization in advance to ensure a smooth entry. All other aspects of your itinerary are confirmed as quoted.

Comparing the selected Alder offer against the unselected Birch distractor reveals distinct terms. For the Alder package, cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. While the booked accommodation includes an operational swimming pool available during the stay without any separate fee, the quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Regarding arrival, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Notably, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary under the current unbooked offer policy for arrival.

Current selected terms completely replace the old policy, which previously stated that a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Under the new terms, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The quoted amount pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Regarding facilities, a swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. If you cancel before the cutoff, the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction.

Q: What is the refund policy? A: Cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Q: Can I arrive at 01:30? A: Two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. One states arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request, while the other states a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Neither overrides the other, so applicable terms are unresolved. Q: Is the pool free? A: The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Q: Is the guided walk included? A: Neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied.
